thesis.final_decision: whether to approve the pinned software implementation of the mtf_combo_v1 prospective FORWARD harness (protocol digest f4d3d6d4c2a22dee8e4c21bdb0c8d91f5b579f4ccb572c0d006901a337a50701) for later, separately authorized stage runs; this packet authorizes no economic run, no FORWARD data read and no live order
thesis.hypothesis: A daily SMA-vote trend regime on BTC (sleeve A) plus an alt long/short sleeve that requires agreement between that regime and a 30-bar gradient-boosting direction filter (sleeve B), 50/50 mixed and volatility-targeted to 20% with cap 2, run as frozen on 11 Binance USDT-M perpetuals with an actual-units book, actual funding and 6 bp fills, keeps a positive and cost-robust return (BASE, 12 bp, one-bar delay) with Sharpe at least 0.5 and max drawdown below 25% over the 12 months from 2026-12-01.
thesis.economic_mechanism: Slow-average regimes are persistent so the regime sign predicts the next weeks return sign more often than not; the classifier adds short-memory direction and its agreement requirement removes entries against it; 0.5/vol sizing equalises position risk; vol targeting cuts exposure when the book is turbulent; costs and funding are paid on actual trades and positions.
thesis.counter_hypothesis: The known-data edge is selection bias plus beta: about 60 variants were tried on 2021-2026H1 and every surviving constant was chosen on that history; the 2023-24 crypto uptrend with a vol target explains the return and the ML filter adds nothing outside its tuning window. The screens accounting (free re-weighting to nominal fractions, 1 bp funding proxy) also flattered the result.
thesis.information_gain: One prospective year on data that did not exist when the constants were frozen distinguishes a persistent trend/filter edge from selection and beta, which no known-data re-analysis can.
thesis.cheapest_falsifier: The FORWARD year itself (no new data source, no new code): any of positive BASE, HIGH_COST and DELAY returns, Sharpe >= 0.5 or max drawdown < 25% failing falsifies the hypothesis; before it, the synthetic oracles falsify the harness arithmetic.
thesis.stop_rule: No change to any constant, lookback, band, hyperparameter, cost, window, cell or rule after any stage result; no rescue run; a ledgered STOPPED_EARLY interim (COMBO__BASE drawdown >= 25%) blocks every later interim and the final; single use of the final and of each interim month is enforced by protocol id and stage across all digests; a software or data refusal needs a result-blind amendment.
thesis.metric_proxy_rationale: Net total return, annual Sharpe and max drawdown of an actual-units book with actual funding and flat per-fill costs, gated jointly in BASE, HIGH_COST and DELAY cells, are the pre-registered proxies for a cost-robust risk-budgeted trend edge; 4h close marks measure drawdown (intrabar drawdown is larger and not measured).
thesis.limitations: This packet certifies software validity only. The 42-feature bank, constants and model were chosen on known-used 2021-2026H1 data and 2026-08..11 perpetual data were partly exposed by other protocols, so nothing known-data is evidence. The model is fitted once per stage run and not walk-forward as in screen q4 (30-bar embargo, per-year bands). Gross leverage is capped at fills only and can exceed 2 between fills (reported as max_held_gross). The G4 relay is planner-written and posted from the owner account; the harness verifies identity and content, not human authorship. One prospective year is one regime and 2190 overlapping observations: not significance, not an edge estimate. Slippage, partial fills, margin, liquidation, borrow and funding-interval changes are not modelled. CI skips the pandas and scikit-learn parity tests; they run locally.

authorities.unit: actual contract units per component (sleeve A and each sleeve-B coin), set only on a nominal-weight or leverage change; net per-coin units for fees and gross
authorities.time: 4h bar labelled by open, decision at its close; features use bars closed at or before it; training labels open before 2026-12-01; funding event t paid in bar j when c_{j-1} <= t < c_j on units held after the fill at c_{j-1}
authorities.state: the book cash, units, shadow unscaled book and leverage schedule (180-bar trailing vol, 20% change band); the sleeve state machines
authorities.sign: longs pay a positive funding rate: cash -= units * price * rate; short units negative
authorities.risk: fill-time gross cap 2 times post-fee equity; invalid cell on non-positive equity, post-fill gross above 2 + 1e-9 or identity breach; held gross reported as max_held_gross
authorities.execution: fill at the decision close (BASE) or the next 4h close (DELAY), fee = rate * sum |net units traded| * price per coin, 6 bp (12 bp HIGH_COST)
authorities.accounting: equity = cash + units * price; cash and mark-to-market reconciliations checked at every mark and fill to 1e-9
authorities.evidence: write-once result.json, hashed raw responses, ledger claim and result keyed by protocol id and stage, receipt with digest, commit, library versions and model-probability hash

unit.statement: Units are held between accepted changes: price 100 to 200 to 100 returns exactly flat equity.
unit.counterexample: Replay a held long through a round trip and a leverage change.
unit.oracle: Hand-computed units and a plain-loop second implementation of the account sequence agree to 1e-9.
unit.known_limitations: Synthetic prices only; does not prove margin or lot-size rules.

time.statement: A feature or decision at close c depends only on data closed at or before c, and no training row has a label bar at or after 2026-12-01.
time.counterexample: Perturb every bar after a truncation point and compare features and cell equity with the full-data run; replay an interim and the later run.
time.oracle: Truncated features equal full-data features at the cut; the interim replay is an exact prefix of the later replay; the label-open cutoff is asserted.
time.known_limitations: Synthetic causality does not prove historical vendor availability.

state.statement: The sleeve state machines (AGREE entry, hold, exit, BTC short filter, fixed entry size) and the leverage schedule follow the spec.
state.counterexample: Drive signals through every transition including flips and non-finite vol.
state.oracle: A separate plain loop re-implements the sleeve state machines and the leverage schedule and agrees to 1e-9 for COMBO, BTC_RULE and ALT_AGREE in BASE, HIGH_COST and DELAY.
state.known_limitations: The oracle shares the spec author's reading of the screens.

sign.statement: Funding sign and timing: a long pays a positive rate, once, on units held after the previous close fill.
sign.counterexample: A funding event just before and just after a decision close.
sign.oracle: Hand-computed cash flows for both signs and timings.
sign.known_limitations: Public funding history only; funding-interval changes are not modelled.

risk.statement: After a fill the gross never exceeds 2 times post-fee equity; a breach would invalidate the cell.
risk.counterexample: A leverage-2 size-1 entry whose fee lowers the equity it was sized on; bypass the clamp.
risk.oracle: Closed-form scale factor on the cap including the fee, and the bypassed clamp yields an invalid cell.
risk.known_limitations: Held gross between fills can exceed 2 and is only reported.

execution.statement: Fees are charged on actual net per-coin notional traded at the fill, including leverage changes, and DELAY fills one 4h bar later.
execution.counterexample: Two components of one coin trading in opposite directions; a one-bar delay.
execution.oracle: Hand-computed fee and fill-bar cases and the plain-loop oracle.
execution.known_limitations: Flat per-fill bp; no slippage, partial fills or impact.

accounting.statement: Equity is cash plus units times price and every fill and mark reconciles.
accounting.counterexample: Random signals across 11 coins with funding, fees and leverage changes.
accounting.oracle: An independent plain loop values equity as cash plus units times price and agrees with the harness to 1e-9; the identity gap is checked at every bar and fill.

evidence.statement: Each stage is single use by protocol id and stage across all digests, a STOPPED_EARLY blocks later runs, and an unclean checkout including untracked files is refused.
evidence.counterexample: Claim the final or an interim month, or a run after a stopped line, under a different digest; add an untracked file.
evidence.oracle: Tests assert refusal before any claim for old digests (final, STOPPED_EARLY, same month) and for a stray untracked module, with ignored files allowed.
evidence.known_limitations: A local ledger can be deleted by the operator; this is operator-enforced, not a lock.

evidence.independent_reconstruction: A plain-loop second implementation of the sleeves, the leverage schedule and the fills recomputes COMBO, BTC_RULE and ALT_AGREE equity from signals without trusting the harness, plus a verbatim pandas copy of the exploratory feature code, truncation causality and hand-computed accounting cases; no market data was read.

permitted: The mtf_combo_forward harness, its synthetic oracles and its ledger, clean-checkout and authorization gates behave as specified at the bound head on synthetic data.
forbidden: Any FORWARD, unused or Binance data dated 2026-12-01 or later read or run under this packet.
Profitability, edge, significance or Sharpe forecast claims from the screens or from synthetic runs.
Paper trading, live orders or capital.
Changing any constant, cell or rule after a stage result, or re-claiming a consumed stage under a new digest.
